verdict.rationale: Attio's Workflows page advertises a "Routing Agent" that "routes every lead to the right rep or channel." It also shows a new-record trigger feeding a Custom Agent that "score[s] the lead and route[s] to the right AE," built on its visual Workflows automation builder. This is the product's own lead-routing capability, but the evidence is marketing-level only: it never shows how owners are assigned, and AI-agent routing may not be deterministic rule-based assignment. Missing for 10: documented assignment-rule configuration, round-robin distribution, owner-field assignment mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
